## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Novita AI) · $0.65/M blended · $0.522 in / $1.044 out per 1M tokens · [novita.ai](https://novita.ai/models/llm/xiaomimimo-mimo-v2.5-pro)

<sub>[price source](https://novita.ai/pricing): USD per 1M tokens, Novita AI serverless chat completions, model xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.5-pro (status active; 1M context): input $0.522, output $1.044; cache read excluded. Xiaomi's own API lists mimo-v2.5-pro at $0.435/$0.87 (overseas, cache miss) but marks it 'to be deprecated' on 2026-10-21. Currency: USD. Novita AI official pricing page, observed 2026-09-25. · [context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro.toml)</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run MiMo-V2.5-Pro (1T-A42B) (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~614.3 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

Other versions: ud-q2_k_xl (~307.4 GB) `llama cli -hf unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF:UD-Q2_K_XL` · ud-iq1_m (~153.95 GB) `llama cli -hf unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF:UD-IQ1_M`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run MiMo-V2.5-Pro (1T-A42B) (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~614.3 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF@UD-Q4_K_XL -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: ud-q2_k_xl (~307.4 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF@UD-Q2_K_XL -y` · ud-iq1_m (~153.95 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-GGUF@UD-IQ1_M -y`
